title: can't format to json with llama3.1-8b model
description:

#### Software execution information

MLE-agent version: 0.3.1
System OS version: ubuntu 20.04.6

#### Problem description
in my scene, i use ollama with llama3.1-8b model.  Following the example instructions,  it throw json format error in step 2.
```
  File "/llm/workspace/MLE-agent/mle/agents/advisor.py", line 134, in interact
    self.report = self.suggest(requirement)
                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/llm/workspace/MLE-agent/mle/agents/advisor.py", line 124, in suggest
    suggestions = json.loads(text)
                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/lib/python3.11/json/__init__.py", line 346, in loads
    return _default_decoder.decode(s)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/lib/python3.11/json/decoder.py", line 337, in decode
    obj, end = self.raw_decode(s, idx=_w(s, 0).end())
               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/lib/python3.11/json/decoder.py", line 355, in raw_decode
    raise JSONDecodeError("Expecting value", s, err.value) from None
```

1. select ollama, when `mle new project`
2. run `mle start --model llama3.1`
